---- MODULE ivy_examples_tlb ----
EXTENDS ivy_examples_tlbDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS

\* Lock ownership and the send/quiescence frontiers are recorded by the
\* existing program counters and todo arrays; no auxiliary state is needed.
\* TLBQuiet characterizes processors that cannot use a stale translation
\* before servicing a shootdown.  TLBConsistent permits a stale translation
\* only there, at Boot, or just after the processor's own page-table update.

TLBLocations == {Boot, MainCheck, MainChoose, MainHandleInterrupt, InitiatorDeactivate, InitiatorLockPmap, InitiatorForSend, InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt, InitiatorWaitForQuiescence, InitiatorUpdateEntry, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap, InitiatorReactivate, ResponderCheck, ResponderDeactivate, ResponderLockAction, ResponderRefreshTlb, ResponderClearActionNeeded, ResponderUnlockAction, ResponderReactivate}
TLBLocked == {InitiatorForSend, InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt, InitiatorWaitForQuiescence, InitiatorUpdateEntry, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap}
TLBInactive == {InitiatorLockPmap, InitiatorForSend, InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt, InitiatorWaitForQuiescence, InitiatorUpdateEntry, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap, InitiatorReactivate, ResponderLockAction, ResponderRefreshTlb, ResponderClearActionNeeded, ResponderUnlockAction, ResponderReactivate}
TLBProcessing == {InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt}
TLBMapped == {InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt}
TLBRLocked == {ResponderRefreshTlb, ResponderClearActionNeeded, ResponderUnlockAction}
TLBResponderPath == {ResponderCheck, ResponderDeactivate, ResponderLockAction}
TLBSend == {InitiatorForSend, InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction,
            InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt}
TLBAfterSend == {InitiatorWaitForQuiescence, InitiatorUpdateEntry,
                 InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap}
TLBAfterWait == {InitiatorUpdateEntry, InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap}
TLBPH(p) == pc[p] \in TLBLocked
TLBAH(p,q) == /\ pc[p] \in {InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction}
              /\ currentcpu[p] = q
TLBRH(q) == pc[q] \in TLBRLocked
TLBSignaled(q) ==
  /\ actionneeded[q]
  /\ interrupt[q] \/ pc[q] \in TLBResponderPath
  /\ ~TLBRH(q)
TLBQuiet(q) ==
  /\ actionneeded[q]
  /\ \/ pc[q] \in {ResponderCheck, ResponderDeactivate, ResponderLockAction,
                       ResponderRefreshTlb, ResponderReactivate}
     \/ /\ interrupt[q]
        /\ pc[q] \in (TLBInactive \ {ResponderRefreshTlb,
                  ResponderClearActionNeeded, ResponderUnlockAction}) \cup {MainHandleInterrupt}
TLBSent(p,q) ==
  \/ pc[p] \in TLBAfterSend
  \/ /\ pc[p] \in TLBSend
     /\ ~todo[p][q]
     /\ ~(pc[p] \in TLBProcessing /\ currentcpu[p] = q)
TLBWaited(p,q) ==
  \/ pc[p] \in TLBAfterWait
  \/ /\ pc[p] = InitiatorWaitForQuiescence
     /\ ~todo[p][q]
TLBType ==
  /\ pc \in [Processor -> TLBLocations]
  /\ userpmap \in [Processor -> PMap]
  /\ writepmap \in [Processor -> PMap]
  /\ currentcpu \in [Processor -> Processor]
  /\ actionlock \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ actionneeded \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ active \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ interrupt \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ plock \in [PMap -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ tlb \in [Processor -> PageEntry]
  /\ pentry \in [PMap -> PageEntry]
  /\ todo \in [Processor -> [Processor -> BOOLEAN]]
  /\ error \in BOOLEAN
TLBActivity == \A p \in Processor : active[p] = (pc[p] \notin TLBInactive)
TLBPmap ==
  /\ \A m \in PMap : plock[m] = (\E p \in Processor : TLBPH(p) /\ writepmap[p] = m)
  /\ \A p,q \in Processor :
       (TLBPH(p) /\ TLBPH(q) /\ writepmap[p] = writepmap[q]) => p = q
TLBAction ==
  \A q \in Processor : actionlock[q] = (TLBRH(q) \/ (\E p \in Processor : TLBAH(p,q)))
TLBCurrent ==
  \A p \in Processor :
    /\ pc[p] \in TLBProcessing =>
         /\ currentcpu[p] # p
         /\ pc[currentcpu[p]] # Boot
    /\ pc[p] \in TLBMapped => userpmap[currentcpu[p]] = writepmap[p]
    /\ pc[p] \in {InitiatorSetActionNeeded, InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt} =>
         ~TLBRH(currentcpu[p])
    /\ pc[p] \in {InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt} => actionneeded[currentcpu[p]]
TLBMessages ==
  \A p,q \in Processor :
    (p # q /\ pc[q] # Boot /\ userpmap[q] = writepmap[p]) =>
      /\ TLBSent(p,q) => TLBSignaled(q)
      /\ TLBWaited(p,q) => TLBQuiet(q)
TLBToDo ==
  \A p,q \in Processor :
    (TLBPH(p) /\ todo[p][q]) => (q # p /\ pc[q] # Boot)
TLBConsistent ==
  \A q \in Processor :
    \/ pc[q] = Boot
    \/ tlb[q] = pentry[userpmap[q]]
    \/ TLBQuiet(q)
    \/ pc[q] = InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb /\ userpmap[q] = writepmap[q]
TLBInv == /\ TLBType /\ TLBActivity /\ TLBPmap /\ TLBAction
          /\ TLBCurrent /\ TLBMessages /\ TLBToDo /\ TLBConsistent /\ ~error
